name: Hentai Gichou no Yabou
source:
The desire to become an idol singer becomes a strong motivation for the girls. Gundam heroines reborn as idol singers in this simulation game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
